brief: brief-after-js177.md item 4: PR 270's nine queue runs failed on nine causes, none the change's; PR 279's first two on its own tests. Options: wait for the count (A), one test process per shard job now (B), B on three PR-detectable failures in 10 (C).
tradeoff: Given up: the full log reading of the 12 runs before 2026-11-22 whose cause a merged task owns, the 8 hours of reproduction outside product suspects, and the separate 20-run of one test. A cause among them that still exists is found when it fails a counted run. Nothing a viewer or operator has.
entry: B and C are rejected for now: no cause found was load, and C's trigger decides integration shards on pull requests (D-069), not B. The 10 counted runs start with the first queued after d7dbeeb, not at JS-175's merge. The count gains a load verdict; two or more in 10 bring one process per shard job back as a priced brief. JS-175 is trimmed: criterion 1's rows owned by a merged task or the queued PR carry run, test and verdict only; criterion 4 reproduces only product suspects, 2 hours each and 4 in all; criterion 6 is counted in the 10 runs; criterion 5's 10-minute rule is applied to the measured time of the next three successful runs (35 minutes or more splits the process). A pull request that adds or changes integration tests runs ci:full once before it is queued. Reopens on: the count.
serves: Owner, 2026-11-22: nothing outruns the product. D-050: never CI capacity or a longer bound. D-058, D-069. PRODUCT.md quality bar: 'Failure modes are designed, tested and reported.'
